searches.finding: Olive-oil HPLC study confirmed. Existing mg/L sample means retained in canonical supplementary records; no mass-density conversion. Pistachio sample range proposed separately.
Purchas et al. measured cooked/uncooked beef and lamb; original numerical table not retrieved. No fabricated universal meat value.
Demarquoy original radioisotopic food analysis located; exact food-specific table unavailable. NIH serving estimate remains explicitly estimated.

USDA release 2 contains betaine and choline moieties. Phosphatidylcholine column is choline contributed by phosphatidylcholine, not phosphatidylcholine molecular mass. No relabelling as PC mg. Exact food/state joins require further reconciliation.
USDA NDB 19165 cocoa quantified; proposed record retains processing and analytical form.
NR and nicotinamide measured in skim milk; nicotinic acid and NAD+ not quantifiable. Do not substitute total niacin or infer NAD+ occurrence.

Original amino-acid database evaluation distinguishes sequence-derived estimates from hydrolysis measurements, which conflate glutamine/glutamate and cystine/cysteine. Exact canonical food, amino-acid form and analytical joins remain unresolved.
Original dehydrated garlic/onion FOS storage study located. Dry solids and chain-length definitions cannot be equated with raw-food values or a combined FOS/GOS protocol. No numerical backfill.
Tested oat malting/soaking supports a bounded presence/protocol proposal, not a generic quantity.
Original isotope-dilution HPLC/MS/MS study located. Vitamer-specific methods support keeping total folate separate; no missing numerical table invented.

Targeted food/nucleoside and cell-wall composition searches did not yield a verified new exact-food numerical mapping in this pass. Existing qualified records retained; no totals or dry-extract yields relabelled as food concentrations.

Five exact canonical food identities verified against USDA API descriptions and IDs; fifteen amino-acid composition mappings proposed. No substitution of free amino-acid concentrations or cooked state.
